observation_only.message: Intelligent Climate is observation-only and cannot change HVAC equipment.

missing_entity.title: Intelligent Climate entity is missing
missing_entity.description: One or more configured thermostats or enabled observation sources no longer exist in Home Assistant. Open the Intelligent Climate integration entry and reconfigure the affected zone to replace or remove the missing references. Continue using the original thermostat for physical HVAC control.

incompatible_entity.title: Intelligent Climate entity is incompatible
incompatible_entity.description: One or more existing observation sources no longer match their configured temperature or humidity binding. Inspect the Intelligent Climate entry and reconfigure the affected zone with a compatible source. Continue using the original thermostat for physical HVAC control.

migration_failed.title: Intelligent Climate configuration could not be validated
migration_failed.description: Intelligent Climate could not safely migrate or validate its persisted configuration, so observation did not start. Inspect the integration entry and logs, then correct or recreate the configuration before reloading. The original thermostat remains available for physical HVAC control.

store_write_failed.title: Intelligent Climate runtime data could not be saved
store_write_failed.description: Intelligent Climate encountered at least three consecutive failures while saving nonauthoritative runtime data. Inspect Home Assistant storage health and logs. In-memory observation can continue, and the original thermostat remains available for physical HVAC control.

command_boundary_violation.title: Intelligent Climate blocked an unexpected control attempt
command_boundary_violation.description: Intelligent Climate received an unexpected physical-command intent and suppressed it. No physical equipment was commanded. Disable the Intelligent Climate integration and report this defect before using it again; continue controlling equipment through the original thermostat.

user.title: Create equipment group
user.description: Define the physical HVAC equipment group to observe. Thermostat selection follows before the entry is created.

data_description.equipment_type: The type of heating and cooling equipment in this group.

thermostat.title: Select thermostat
thermostat.description: Select the one existing climate entity owned by this equipment group.

data_description.thermostat_entity_id: An existing Home Assistant climate entity that is not owned by another Intelligent Climate entry.
